mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_emotion ( user_id, content, record_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{content}, #{recordDate}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT emotion_id, user_id, content, record_date, created_at FROM daily_emotion WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate} ORDER BY created_at ASC, emotion_id ASC
